user.title: Add a Tilt roller shade
user.description: Enter the shade's Bluetooth MAC address.

key.title: Pairing key
key.description: Enter the 64-character hex pairing key for {name}. Rescue it from the Tilt cloud store (see the smartblinds-ble docs). The key is validated against the shade before saving.

error.invalid_key_format: The pairing key must be exactly 64 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_key: That key did not authenticate this shade.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the shade over Bluetooth. Make sure a proxy is in range and no phone or the Tilt app is holding the connection.
